**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is considering getting a new mouse because their current one is worn out and has a stuck scroll wheel.

- [PREFERENCE] The user loves the quiet keys of the Logitech keyboard and appreciates its great battery life.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested considering brand reputation, sensor accuracy, button quality, ergonomics, wired vs. wireless options, and additional features when choosing a gaming mouse.

- [PREFERENCE] The user is considering getting a cable management system to organize their computer cables.

- [PREFERENCE] The user is looking at a Western Digital portable external hard drive priced at $100.
